answer: What keeps this honest is fraud-proof window for optimistic state claims, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 604 pays 9664 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The wharf of the design is public, the nadir of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the violet of honest work is what finally pays. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
